description: A human looked at a swept entry and says it is real (or marks it private). Confirmation is the load-bearing layer: machine-found claims never reach the pooled corpus without it.

private.description: keep it on the tab, never let it leave the box — not in a delta, not in a shared count

tool_name.description: the swept entry to confirm, by canonical name

name: confirm_entry
title: Confirm an Entry
